headline: edge phase 1 on the 509: 1831 individually critical edges of 2442 deletable, so e_min >= 1831 against the published 2406

external_calibration.claim: c <= 2406, because [deGreyParts2023]'s 36-edge reduction is itself a refusing subgraph and therefore contains every critical edge
external_calibration.if_failed: either this instrument is wrong or their footnote is; it is a control and not a finding either way
external_calibration.fork: c < 2406: there are individually-removable edges they missed, the minimum lies in [c, 2406], and the gap is the hitting set's to close. It does not collapse on its own -- individually removable is not jointly removable, so c is a floor and not the answer

degree_floor.note: the centre is critical too, so every one of the 509 vertices is, and the §O6 floor rises from 1016 to 1018

budget.mechanism: conf_budget + solve_limited slices; cadical153 does not implement interrupt() (measured 2026-09-11)

note: a singleton correction set IS a critical edge, so the count of individually critical edges is a rigorous LOWER bound on the exact edge minimum. If it equals 2406 the published greedy discard was optimal after all; if it is lower there is room and the hitting set says how much.
